name: Pierre Elliott Trudeau Foundation Doctoral Scholarship
amount: Up to CA$50,000/year for 3 years (min. CA$25,000) + CA$20,000/year research & travel allowance
dlText: 2027 competition: 6 Nov 2026, 16:00 ET (eligibility confirmation was due 2 Oct 2026)
tags: Must be enrolled in a PhD at a Canadian university
fields: Humanities and social sciences aligned with the Foundation's four themes (e.g. human rights and dignity, Canada and the world)
note: International students qualify only if already enrolled in a doctoral programme at a Canadian university; applicants had to request eligibility confirmation by 2 Oct 2026.

name: Ontario Trillium Scholarship (OTS)
host: Government of Ontario with Ontario universities
amount: CA$40,000/year, renewable up to 4 years
dlText: Universities nominate admitted international PhD applicants; internal dates vary by university
tags: Direct-entry PhD at an Ontario university
note: About 75 awards a year across Ontario; there is no separate application—apply to a PhD programme at a participating Ontario university and ask the department about OTS nomination.

name: NVIDIA Graduate Fellowship
amount: Up to US$60,000 + mandatory paid summer internship at NVIDIA
dlText: 2027–28 cycle: 30 Oct 2026 (closed; time not stated)
tags: Internship in summer before award year
fields: Computing research relevant to NVIDIA (AI, graphics, systems, robotics, etc.)
note: Applicants must have finished their first PhD year; winners are notified ~15 Jan and must do an in-person internship at an NVIDIA research office.

name: Apple Scholars in AI/ML PhD Fellowship
amount: PhD funding support + Apple internship opportunity + mentorship (check official page)
dlText: Nomination by invited universities; internal deadlines set by each university
note: You cannot apply directly: only universities invited by Apple can nominate students; ask your department whether it participates.

name: Microsoft Research Fellowship
amount: check official page
dlText: 2026 call closed Nov 2025 (exact date not on an official page); next call not announced
nextText: Next call not yet announced — watch the official page
fields: Computing research challenges set by Microsoft Research
note: Replaced the old nomination-based PhD Fellowship: PhD students (with faculty approval) or faculty submit proposals to specific research challenges; your university must be in an eligible region.

name: Bloomberg Data Science Ph.D. Fellowship
amount: Full tuition + US$45,000 stipend + 14-week paid summer internship each year
dlText: 2027–28 cycle: 25 Sep 2026, 23:59 AoE (closed)
fields: Machine learning, NLP, information retrieval and related data science
note: Recipients notified by 18 Dec 2026; fellows intern at Bloomberg each summer they hold the award.

name: Two Sigma PhD Fellowship
amount: Up to US$75,000/year for 2 years (paid to university) + one-time US$10,000 to the student
dlText: 25 Sep 2026, 12:00 ET (closed)
tags: Full-time PhD at a US university
fields: Applied mathematics, AI/computer science, physics, statistics
note: Open regardless of nationality but only to students at accredited US universities; students apply directly with a 750-word research proposal.

name: Jane Street Graduate Research Fellowship
country: Any (US, Canada, UK, Europe, Australia, NZ, Singapore universities)
amount: One year of tuition & fees + US$50,000 stipend
dlText: 13 Nov 2026, AoE (letters due 1 Dec 2026)
tags: 1+ year left in PhD (or starting Fall 2027)
fields: Electrical engineering & computer science, mathematics, physics, statistics
note: Students committed to starting a PhD in Fall 2027 can also apply; the university must be in one of the listed regions.

name: Hertz Fellowship
amount: Up to 5 years: stipend + full tuition equivalent
dlText: 2027 fellowship: 30 Oct 2026, 23:59 PT (closed)
fields: Applied physical and biological sciences, mathematics, engineering
note: Permanent residents also qualify (proof required); not open to international students. Finalists named Feb 2027, awards announced May 2027.

name: NSF Graduate Research Fellowship Program (GRFP)
amount: ~US$159,000 per fellowship (3 years of support usable over 5 years)
dlText: 19–23 Oct 2026, 20:00 ET depending on field (CS/engineering-adjacent: 20 Oct) — closed
tags: First year of first graduate degree
fields: STEM and STEM education, psychology and social sciences
note: Not open to international students; permanent residents qualify. Solicitation NSF 26-526 offers ~1,500 awards.

name: AAUW International Fellowships
amount: US$25,000 (doctorate) / US$20,000 (master's), paid in two instalments

eligibility.note: Women who are not US citizens or permanent residents (check the official eligibility page)

note: For women who are not US citizens or permanent residents studying full-time in the US; awards announced ~Mar 2027.

name: Funded PhD programmes (United States) – how it works
amount: Typically full tuition + health insurance + stipend (e.g. Princeton 2026-27: $52,680–$55,440/12 months)
dlText: Apply to each department; deadlines mostly 1 Dec – early Jan for autumn entry
tags: Funding via fellowship, RA or TA
note: At most research-intensive US universities an admitted PhD student receives a package of tuition waiver, health cover and a living stipend, paid through fellowships and teaching/research assistantships; there is no separate scholarship application. International students are generally funded on the same terms but check each department.

name: Funded PhD programmes (Canada) – how it works
amount: Department funding package (stipend + TA/RA + awards), amounts set by faculty/programme
dlText: Apply to each programme; deadlines mostly Dec–Jan for September entry
tags: Many offer tuition offsets for internationals
note: Canadian PhD students usually receive a multi-year funding package combining stipends, TA/RA work and awards; minimums are set by each university or faculty (McGill has no university-wide minimum), and several universities cover the international tuition differential.

name: Princeton University PhD funding guarantee
amount: Full tuition + student health plan + stipend $52,680–$55,440 (2026-27, 12 months)
dlText: Varies by department: 1, 15 or 21 Dec 2026 (e.g. Computer Science PhD 15 Dec 2026; time not stated)
tags: All regularly enrolled PhD students funded
note: Princeton guarantees full funding for all years of regular PhD enrolment, subject to satisfactory progress; support is a mix of fellowships and assistantships and is not tied to citizenship.

name: Harvard Griffin GSAS PhD funding guarantee
host: Harvard Kenneth C. Griffin Graduate School of Arts and Sciences
amount: Tuition grants + stipend (minimum ≥$50,000/year announced 2024) for at least 5 years
dlText: Varies by programme: 1 Dec 2026 – 5 Jan 2027, 17:00 ET (e.g. Engineering & Applied Sciences 15 Dec 2026)
tags: Guaranteed 5 years for all PhD students
note: Harvard Griffin GSAS guarantees stipend and tuition support for the first five years to all PhD students; tuition and health grants extend beyond year five in longer programmes.

name: MIT EECS PhD funding
host: Massachusetts Institute of Technology, Dept. of Electrical Engineering & Computer Science
amount: Tuition + monthly stipend (TA rate $4,695/month AY 2026-27) + medical insurance
dlText: 1 Dec 2026 (time not stated); letters/transcripts by early Jan
note: MIT EECS states PhD students are fully funded for the whole programme (tuition, stipend, medical insurance), subject to satisfactory progress; admitted students are automatically considered for fellowships and assistantships.

name: Stanford University PhD funding (5-year support)
amount: Tuition + stipend/salary + health subsidy (e.g. Chemistry ≥$58,460 first year 2026-27)
dlText: Varies by department (e.g. Computer Science PhD 8 Dec 2026, EE 1 Dec 2026 23:59 PST; CS time not stated)
note: Stanford departments describe five years of guaranteed support for PhD students in good standing (tuition plus stipend via fellowships, TA/RA); exact amounts and terms are set per department.

name: Caltech PhD financial support
amount: Full tuition & mandatory fees + stipend $50,000/12 months (from 1 Sep 2026)
dlText: Varies by option, 15 Nov – 15 Dec 2026 (e.g. Mechanical & Civil Eng. 15 Dec; Biology 1 Dec; time not stated)
tags: Work authorisation needed for most sources
note: All Caltech PhD students are offered full tuition/fees coverage plus a living stipend, conditional on full-time enrolment and progress; most funding sources require US work authorisation (standard for F-1 TA/RA roles).

name: Carnegie Mellon School of Computer Science PhD funding
host: Carnegie Mellon University, School of Computer Science
amount: Stipend + tuition + university fees + health insurance (check department for current stipend)
dlText: Final deadline 9 Dec 2026, 15:00 EST (early deadline 18 Nov 2026, lower fee)
fields: Computer science, machine learning, robotics, language technologies and other SCS programmes
note: CMU's Computer Science Department offers all admitted PhD students comprehensive support (stipend, tuition, fees, health insurance) on the same basis for international students, continuing while in good standing.

name: UC Berkeley EECS PhD funding
amount: Tuition + stipend via fellowship/GSR/TA (details in offer)
tags: All incoming PhD students offered support
note: Berkeley EECS offers support to all incoming doctoral students; applicants are automatically considered and funding details come with the admission offer.

name: Yale GSAS PhD funding package
host: Yale Graduate School of Arts and Sciences
amount: Full tuition ($52,400, 2026-27) + 12-month stipend (min. $52,046–$53,629) + health coverage
dlText: Varies by programme: 1 Dec 2026, 15 Dec 2026 or 2 Jan 2027 (e.g. Political Science 15 Dec 2026; time not stated)
note: Each Yale GSAS PhD student receives a fellowship covering full tuition, a 12-month stipend and health coverage for typically at least five years; sixth-year support is not guaranteed.

name: Columbia GSAS PhD guaranteed funding
host: Columbia University Graduate School of Arts and Sciences
amount: Stipend + tuition + health and university fees (incl. international fees) for 5–6 years
dlText: Varies by programme: 25 Nov 2026 – 7 Jan 2027 (e.g. Philosophy, Statistics 7 Jan 2027; time not stated)
note: Columbia GSAS doctoral students normally receive the prevailing stipend plus tuition, health and (if applicable) international fees for five or six years depending on field and good standing.

name: University of Toronto Computer Science PhD funding package
host: University of Toronto, Department of Computer Science
amount: International base package CA$41,122/year (2026-27) + up to CA$7,948 enhanced; international tuition ~CA$36,700
dlText: 1 Dec 2026 (firm; time not stated)
note: U of T CS funds all full-time PhD students through RA and TA appointments, guaranteed for 48 months (60 for direct-entry); the university base of $40,000/year includes tuition.

name: UBC Four Year Doctoral Fellowship (4YF)
amount: CA$24,000/year stipend + tuition for up to 4 years (from Sep 2026)
dlText: No separate application – admitted PhD applicants considered automatically (programme deadlines vary)
note: UBC's 4YF is a merit award for top doctoral students, held by domestic and international students alike; eligible international students also get the International Tuition Award.

name: McGill PhD funding (international tuition differential coverage)
amount: International tuition differential covered for all international PhD students; stipends set by faculty (e.g. BBME min. CA$25,000)
dlText: No separate application; programme admission deadlines vary
tags: All international PhDs: tuition differential covered
95% of PhDs have full tuition covered
note: McGill has no university-wide stipend minimum, but all international PhD students receive funding covering the difference between Quebec-resident and international tuition; most also receive living-cost support from their faculty.

name: University of Waterloo PhD minimum funding + International Doctoral Student Award
amount: Min. CA$29,145/year (from May 2026) + IDSA ≈ international–domestic tuition difference (e.g. CS intl PhD CA$51,090)
dlText: No separate application; programme admission deadlines vary
note: Waterloo guarantees minimum funding to full-time doctoral students in good standing within time limits, and international PhD students additionally receive the IDSA; departments often exceed the minimum.

name: Canada Graduate Research Scholarship – Doctoral (CGRS-D)
amount: CA$40,000/year for 36 months
dlText: Direct-to-agency: 17 Oct, 20:00 ET (next business day if weekend → 19 Oct 2026); university internal deadlines earlier (e.g. U of T CS 8 Sep 2026) (estimated from NSERC's standing 17 Oct / next-business-day rule; most universities set earlier internal deadlines)
tags: Must be registered in a Canadian PhD
Up to 15% of awards for internationals
fields: All fields (via NSERC, SSHRC or CIHR)
note: International students qualify only once registered in a doctoral programme at an eligible Canadian institution and must hold the award in Canada; most apply through their university's quota process.

eligibility.note: New Americans: green-card holders, naturalised citizens, DACA recipients, those born abroad who graduated from US high school and college, or US-born children of two immigrants

name: Paul & Daisy Soros Fellowships for New Americans
host: Paul & Daisy Soros Fellowships for New Americans
amount: Up to $90,000 ($40,000 tuition + $25,000/year stipend for 2 years)
dlText: 2027 fellowship: 29 Oct 2026, 14:00 ET (closed)
nextText: Next round expected to open spring 2027
tags: Immigrants / children of immigrants to the US
note: Merit fellowship for immigrants and children of immigrants starting or continuing a full-time graduate degree in the US; 30 or younger at the deadline.
